# MailFlow
> Free, privacy-friendly web application for sending personalized bulk emails via Google OAuth 2.0 or custom SMTP.

MailFlow (hosted at https://www.mailflow.tech) is an open-source, browser-based mass email automation tool designed for founders, recruiters, educators, and marketers. It allows users to upload contact lists (Excel `.xlsx`, `.xls` or `.csv`), define personalized template variables (such as `{{First Name}}`), attach global or recipient-specific files, and send campaigns directly through their own Gmail or SMTP accounts without subscription fees or contact limits.

## Core Features
- **Gmail OAuth 2.0 Integration**: Send directly from your verified Google account using official Google APIs. No App Passwords required.
- **Custom SMTP Support**: Works with any SMTP provider (Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark, custom private servers).
- **Client-Side Spreadsheet Parsing**: Reads Excel (`.xlsx`, `.xls`) and CSV files instantly in the browser using SheetJS.
- **Dynamic Personalization**: Automatically detects columns in the uploaded file and generates variable tags like `{{Name}}`, `{{Company}}`, `{{Invoice}}` for subject and body text.
- **Per-Recipient Attachments**: Automatically matches and attaches distinct files or PDFs to specific recipients based on spreadsheet column mappings.
- **Privacy & Security First**: User contact lists and recipient email addresses are processed in memory and never stored in any database. OAuth tokens are stored in secure HTTP-only session cookies with strict session lifetimes.
- **Live Dispatch Terminal**: Real-time progress tracking with pause, resume, and abort controls, pacing delay control to comply with provider rate limits, and detailed error logs.

## Use Cases
- Cold email outreach and sales prospecting
- Candidate recruitment and interview scheduling
- Client invoicing and payment reminders with custom PDF attachments
- Event invitations, RSVP notifications, and community newsletters
- Academic and club announcements
